files.description: Universal shared TypeScript interfaces, DTOs, E2EE key models, WebSocket message frames, and JSDoc contracts.
Deterministic 2D rigid-body striker, coin collision, and pocket simulation engine.
Carrom board game rules, foul logic, queen coverage, and turn state transition handler.
Ludo 4-player token track, yard, safety zones, dice roll validation, and capture rules.
Connect Four column drop physics, gravity landing calculations, and 4-in-a-row victory detection.
PostgreSQL database schema with 22 models, zero-knowledge columns, cascades, and field docstrings.
Authentication REST API controller handling register, login, token refresh, and account profile endpoints.
Authentication service managing argon2 password hashing, JWT minting, and rate limiting.
Server workspace REST controller: workspace creation, channel provisioning, and custom role hierarchy.
Real-time WebSocket chat gateway (/ws/chat) managing channel subscriptions, typing indicators, and fanout.
Encrypted message persistence REST API, attachment metadata, emoji reactions, and message pins.
E2EE cryptographic device key registry and channel key exchange distribution API.
WebRTC mesh switchboard gateway (/ws/call) handling SDP offer/answer relay, ICE candidates, and game referees.
Call service REST API providing TURN relay credentials, channel voice rosters, and call histories.
Presence WebSocket gateway managing Redis heartbeat leases, online/idle/dnd state, and mutual visibility.
Presence REST API for reciprocal last seen visibility, friendship rosters, and user blocklists.
Notification REST controller managing unread counters, push suppression windows, and notification preferences.
Remote Desktop WebRTC signaling gateway for low-latency screen capture and mouse/keyboard input injection.
Remote desktop machine enrolment tokens, permission grants (VIEW, CONTROL, CLIPBOARD), and active session auditing.
Android native Kotlin E2EE cryptographic engine: device identity key generation, channel key unwrapping, and backup sealing.
Hardware-backed Android KeyStore wrapper for StrongBox / TEE AES-256-GCM master key encryption.
Electron main process controller: window lifecycle, native menus, secure IPC bridge, and auto-updates.
Unified local reverse-proxy ingress gateway routing ports 3001-3008 through localhost:8090 with WebSockets.
Monorepo root package.json configuration, workspace scripts, and devDependencies.

{
  "name": "betweenus",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.1-alpha.25",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.0.0",
  "license": "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "turbo run build",
    "dev": "turbo run dev dev:gateway",
    "dev:backend": "turbo run dev --filter=./apps/services/*",
    "dev:gateway": "node scripts/dev-gateway.mjs",
    "dev:infra": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d",
    "dev:infra:down": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml down",
    "postinstall": "node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs",
    "dev:desktop": "node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm --filter @betweenus/desktop dev",
    "dev:web": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/web dev",
    "dev:web:lan": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/web dev --mode lan",
    "dev:admin": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/admin dev",
    "dev:duo": "node scripts/dev-duo.mjs",
    "docs": "npm --prefix docs run start",
    "docs:build": "npm --prefix docs run build",
    "docs:install": "npm --prefix docs install",
    "desktop:package": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/desktop package",
    "desktop:package:win": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/desktop package:win",
    "desktop:package:win-packaged": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/desktop package:win-packaged",
    "android": "node scripts/android.mjs",
    "android:build": "node scripts/android.mjs assembleDebug",
    "android:run": "node scripts/android.mjs run",
    "android:test": "node scripts/android.mjs testDebugUnitTest",
    "data:path": "node scripts/data-path.mjs",
    "firebase:env": "node scripts/firebase-env.mjs",
    "db:backup": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm -e BACKUP_ON_MIGRATE=1 db-backup-once",
    "prod:build": "pnpm build",
    "prod:up": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml pull && docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d",
    "prod:up:build": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.build.yml up -d --build",
    "prod:down": "docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml down",
    "lint": "turbo run lint",
    "typecheck": "turbo run typecheck",
    "check": "node scripts/dev-gateway.mjs --check && node scripts/release-version.mjs --check && node scripts/release-notes.mjs --check && sh -n .github/scripts/decode-keystore.sh && sh -n .github/scripts/retag.sh && sh .github/scripts/detect-check.sh && turbo run check",
    "db:generate": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database generate",
    "db:migrate": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database migrate",
    "db:migrate:check": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database migrate:check",
    "db:seed": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database seed",
    "admin:create": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database admin:create",
    "db:studio": "pnpm --filter @betweenus/database studio"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@resvg/resvg-js": "^2.6.2",
    "turbo": "^2.0.0",
    "typescript": "^5.5.4"
  }
}
